On Your Turn
Each turn you can Move, take one Action, maybe one Bonus Action, and between turns one Reaction.
Actions
  • Cast a spell (see the Spell Reference pages)
  • Attack with a weapon or damaging cantrip (see Skills page)
  • Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Hide, Help, Search, Ready, Shove, Grapple, Influence, Study, Utilize
Bonus Actions
  • Expeditious Retreat
Reactions
  • Opportunity Attack when a creature leaves your reach
  • Cast a spell with a Reaction casting time
House Rules
  • Catch your breath. Out of combat, spend one Hit Die + your Constitution modifier to heal. Up to 3 times all run; mark each on the Hit Dice track above.
  • Spellcasting. Cast any spell of a type you can cast from a found Spell Book, if you have the slots. You can reach one level above your normal maximum by spending two slots of the level just below it: two level-1 slots cast a level-2 spell, two level-2 slots cast a level-3 spell like Fireball. That over-level cast needs a spellcasting check (DC 10 + the spell's level). The slots are spent whether you pass or fail, and a failure fizzles the spell.

Who You Are

Your Ancestry: Drow

Your ancestry gives you a few natural traits.

Keen Senses. You have proficiency in the Perception skill.
Fey Ancestry. You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can’t put you to sleep.
Trance. Elves don’t need to sleep. Instead, they meditate deeply, remaining semiconscious, for 4 hours a day. (The Common word for such meditation is trance. ) While meditating, you can dream after a fashion;
Superior Darkvision. Your darkvision has a radius of 120 feet.
Sunlight Sensitivity. You have disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.
Drow Magic. You know the dancing lights cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the faerie fire spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest.
Drow Weapon Training. You have proficiency with rapiers, shortswords, and hand crossbows.
Your Background: Criminal

You eked out a living in dark alleyways, cutting purses or burgling shops. Perhaps you were part of a small gang of like-minded wrongdoers who looked out for each other.

Trained Skills. Sleight of Hand and Stealth (already on your Skills page).
Tools. Thieves’ Tools.
Origin Feat. Alert (explained under Your Feats).
Your Feats

Feats are special perks from your background and choices, on top of your class.

Alert. Origin Feat. You gain the following benefits. Initiative Proficiency. When you roll Initiative, you can add your Proficiency Bonus to the roll. Initiative Swap. Immediately after you roll Initiative, you can swap your Initiative with the Initiative of one willing ally in the same combat.
Weapon Mastery. Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change the kinds of weapons you chose.
Dark Bargain. A pact perk from your backstory. Confirm its exact effect with your DM before play.
Your Class: Rogue (Arcane Trickster)

A Dexterous Expert in Stealth and Subterfuge. Rogues have a knack for finding the solution to just about any problem, prioritizing subtle strikes over brute strength. Primary Ability: Dexterity. Hit Point Die: D8. Saves: Dexterity & Intelligence

Enhance Stealth with Arcane Spells. Some Rogues enhance their fine-honed skills of stealth and agility with spells, learning magical tricks to aid them in their trade.

Sneak Attack. Free (once per turn). Once per turn, deal an extra 2d6 damage to a creature you hit with a Finesse or Ranged weapon, if you have Advantage on the attack or if an enemy of the target is within 5 ft of it and you don't have Disadvantage.
Cunning Action. Bonus Action. On your turn, take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action as a Bonus Action.

Who You Are

Steady Aim. Bonus Action. If you haven't moved this turn, give yourself Advantage on your next attack roll this turn. Your Speed becomes 0 until the end of the turn.
Expertise. Passive. You have Expertise (double your proficiency bonus) in two skills. They are marked on your Skills page.
Weapon Mastery. Passive. You can use the mastery property of two kinds of weapons you chose.
Mage Hand Legerdemain. Bonus Action. You can cast Mage Hand as a Bonus Action and make the spectral hand Invisible. You can control it as a Bonus Action and use it to make Sleight of Hand checks, pick locks, and disarm traps at a distance.

Spell Reference

Cantrips — cast any time, no slot needed
Fire BoltEvocation Cantrip
Casting Time: ActionRange: 120 ftComponents: V, SDuration: Instantaneous
Spell attack

You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or an object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell starts burning if it isn’t being worn or carried.

Cantrip Upgrade. The damage increases by 1d10 when you reach levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).

Mage HandConjuration Cantrip
Casting Time: ActionRange: 30 ftComponents: V, SDuration: 1 minute

A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.

When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.

As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.

The hand can’t attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

Dancing LightsEvocation Cantripvia race
Casting Time: ActionRange: 120 ftComponents: V, S, M (a bit of phosphorus or wychwood, or a glowworm)Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Concentration

You create up to four torch-sized lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover in the air for the duration. You can also combine the four lights into one glowing vaguely humanoid form of Medium size. Whichever form you choose, each light sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius.

As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the lights up to 60 feet to a new spot within range. A light must be within 20 feet of another light created by this spell, and a light winks out if it exceeds the spell's range.

Level 1 Spells — each casting spends a slot
ShieldLevel 1 Abjuration
Casting Time: ReactionRange: SelfComponents: V, SDuration: 1 round

An imperceptible barrier of magical force protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from Magic Missile.

The Vault of the Starving MindPage 6

Spell Reference

Chromatic OrbLevel 1 Evocation
Casting Time: ActionRange: 90 ftComponents: V, S, M (a diamond worth 50+ GP)Duration: Instantaneous
Spell attack

You hurl an orb of energy at a target within range. Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder for the type of orb you create, and then make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 3d8 damage of the chosen type.

If you roll the same number on two or more of the d8s, the orb leaps to a different target of your choice within 30 feet of the target. Make an attack roll against the new target, and make a new damage roll. The orb can’t leap again unless you cast the spell with a level 2+ spell slot.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1. The orb can leap a maximum number of times equal to the level of the slot expended, and a creature can be targeted only once by each casting of this spell.

Expeditious RetreatLevel 1 Transmutation
Casting Time: Bonus ActionRange: SelfComponents: V, SDuration: Concentration, up to 10 minute
Concentration

You take the Dash action, and until the spell ends, you can take that action again as a Bonus Action.

Faerie FireLevel 1 Evocationvia race
Casting Time: ActionRange: 60 ftComponents: VDuration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
ConcentrationSaving throw

Each object in a 20-foot cube within range is outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice). Any creature in the area when the spell is cast is also outlined in light if it fails a Dexterity saving throw. For the duration, objects and affected creatures shed dim light in a 10-foot radius.

Any attack roll against an affected creature or object has advantage if the attacker can see it, and the affected creature or object can't benefit from being invisible.
